cohort: The study included 800 primiparous women recruited from health centers in Tabriz, Iran.
finding: Negative childbirth experience was an independent predictive factor for women's reluctance towards subsequent pregnancies and subsequent vaginal birth.
mod_finding: Negative childbirth experience was found to be an independent predictive factor for women's reluctance towards subsequent vaginal birth.
cross-section timing: After their first childbirth experience, at an unspecified time point.
